title: The Latest: What Happened in Iowa?

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无保留、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日于 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Iowa City!
sentences.zh: 爱荷华城！

sentences.en: All of the game day excitement is shifting to Iowa.
sentences.zh: 所有比赛日的兴奋情绪都转移到了爱荷华州。

sentences.en: The shape of the 2020 race could change dramatically.
sentences.zh: 2020年大选的格局可能会发生戏剧性的变化。

sentences.en: Today marks the beginning of the end for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 今天标志着唐纳德·特朗普末日的开始。

sentences.en: What happened in Iowa?
sentences.zh: 爱荷华州发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, it looks like it's going to be a long night.
sentences.zh: 嗯，看来这将是一个漫长的夜晚。

sentences.en: We're not feeling good.
sentences.zh: 我们感觉不太妙。

sentences.en: This is a real hit when it comes to, A, the Iowa caucus, and B, faith that people have in free and fair elections in this country.
sentences.zh: 这对于 A，爱荷华州党团会议，以及 B，人们对这个国家自由公正选举的信心来说，都是沉重的打击。

sentences.en: It is too close to call, so I'm just going to tell you what I do know.
sentences.zh: 现在难分胜负，所以我只能告诉你我所知道的情况。

sentences.en: Good afternoon, and thank you all so much for taking a little time today to chat a little bit about what happened last night.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好，非常感谢大家今天花点时间聊聊昨晚发生的事情。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Alex Burns, political reporter for the New York Times, still stuck in a hotel in Des Moines at 6.40 p.m.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是《纽约时报》政治记者亚历克斯·伯恩斯，周二下午 6 点 40 分仍然困在得梅因的一家酒店里。

sentences.en: Central Time on Tuesday as we continue to wait for the final results of the Iowa caucus.
sentences.zh: 中部时间，我们继续等待爱荷华州党团会议的最终结果。

sentences.en: The story of today has been that after last night's debacle, when some combination of human and technological error prevented the results from being announced, everyone was
sentences.zh: 今天的故事是，在昨晚的惨败之后——当时人为和技术错误的某种结合导致结果无法公布——每个人都在

sentences.en: waiting impatiently for a 3.45 p.m.
sentences.zh: 焦急地等待下午 3 点 45 分

sentences.en: announcement from the Iowa Democratic Party chair, Troy Price.
sentences.zh: 爱荷华州民主党主席特洛伊·普莱斯的宣布。

sentences.en: The reporting of the results and circumstances surrounding the 2020 Iowa Democratic Party caucuses were unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 2020年爱荷华州民主党党团会议结果的汇报以及相关情况是不可接受的。

sentences.en: He comes out about 20 minutes late to start the briefing.
sentences.zh: 他迟到了大约 20 分钟才开始简报。

sentences.en: As chair of the party, I apologize deeply for this.
sentences.zh: 作为党的主席，我对此深表歉意。

sentences.en: He apologizes.
sentences.zh: 他道歉了。

sentences.en: How can anyone trust you now?
sentences.zh: 现在怎么还有人能信任你？

sentences.en: We have been working day and night.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在夜以继日地工作。

sentences.en: Take some annoyed questions from reporters.
sentences.zh: 回答记者们一些恼火的问题。

sentences.en: And how can you ensure Americans, assure Americans, that these are verifiably accurate results?
sentences.zh: 你们怎么能向美国人保证，向美国人保证，这些是经得起核实的准确结果？

sentences.en: Well, we're going to take the time we need to get these results done now that we have the first batch that's going to be coming out here in a couple of minutes.
sentences.zh: 好吧，既然我们将在几分钟后迎来第一批公布的结果，我们将花必要的时间把这些结果做好。

sentences.en: And says the results are about to go live.
sentences.zh: 并表示结果即将上线。

sentences.en: So all of us still here in Des Moines immediately start hitting refresh on the Iowa Democratic Party website.
sentences.zh: 于是我们所有还留在得梅因的人立刻开始刷新爱荷华州民主党网站。

sentences.en: And here, in just a couple of minutes, we will be reporting.
sentences.zh: 就在几分钟后，我们将进行报道。

sentences.en: But basically 18 hours after we expected the results, they are still a long, long way from complete.
sentences.zh: 但基本上在预期结果出炉 18 小时后，距离完整结果还差得很远很远。

sentences.en: 62 percent of precincts from all 99 counties.
sentences.zh: 来自全部 99 个县的 62% 的选区。

sentences.en: Only 62 percent of the precincts have been reported.
sentences.zh: 只有 62% 的选区公布了结果。

sentences.en: And look, I understand how much pressure the Iowa Democratic Party is under, but it seems like a highly questionable decision to make people wait this long for any information and
sentences.zh: 听着，我理解爱荷华州民主党承受着多大的压力，但让人们等这么久才得到任何信息，这似乎是一个非常值得怀疑的决定，

sentences.en: then release only an incomplete picture.
sentences.zh: 然后只发布不完整的画面。

sentences.en: Anyways, thank you all folks.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，谢谢大家。

sentences.en: The results are coming in.
sentences.zh: 结果正在出炉。

sentences.en: We will see you later.
sentences.zh: 我们回头见。

sentences.en: So immediately you see cable television trying to make sense of it in real time.
sentences.zh: 所以你会立刻看到有线电视试图实时解读它。

sentences.en: And there you go.
sentences.zh: 就这样。

sentences.en: So how does Sanders lead in the state delegate equivalent?
sentences.zh: 那么桑德斯如何在州代表等效数上领先？

sentences.en: Excuse me.
sentences.zh: 不好意思。

sentences.en: How does Buttigieg lead in the state delegate equivalent?
sentences.zh: 布蒂吉格如何在州代表等效数上领先？

sentences.en: If he's not leading on the second allocation, it gets into it.
sentences.zh: 如果他在第二轮分配中没有领先，这就涉及到这一点了。

sentences.en: I got to take a look here very closely.
sentences.zh: 我得仔细看看这里。

sentences.en: But as we're recording this, it still remains unclear when we will actually know the final results of the Iowa caucuses.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们录制时所说，我们什么时候才能真正知道爱荷华州党团会议的最终结果仍不得而知。

sentences.en: What is clear is that Pete Buttigieg and Bernie Sanders are the two candidates who have pulled ahead away from the rest of the pack and that Joe Biden has really fallen behind.
sentences.zh: 明确的是，皮特·布蒂吉格和伯尼·桑德斯是甩开其他人处于领先地位的两名候选人，而乔·拜登确实落后了。

sentences.en: But the latest is that the importance of those results really feels diminished in a meaningful way as a result of all this chaos.
sentences.zh: 但最新情况是，由于所有这些混乱，这些结果的重要性感觉已经大幅减弱。

sentences.en: Typically, two things happen after Iowa.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，爱荷华州之后会发生两件事。

sentences.en: You see some candidates drop out and you see one candidate claim victory and try to turn that into momentum heading into New Hampshire.
sentences.zh: 你会看到一些候选人退选，你会看到一位候选人宣布胜利，并试图将其转化为进军新罕布什尔州的势头。

sentences.en: But the way this is all played out, neither thing, clear losers, clear winners, is really happening yet.
sentences.zh: 但就目前的发展来看，无论是清晰的失败者还是清晰的胜利者，都还没有真正出现。

sentences.en: There's still too much uncertainty about who the number one candidate will ultimately be.
sentences.zh: 对于最终谁会成为头号候选人，仍有太多不确定性。

sentences.en: In fact, right now, Bernie Sanders is winning the popular vote while Pete Buttigieg is winning in the state delegate count.
sentences.zh: 事实上，就在现在，伯尼·桑德斯在普选票数上获胜，而皮特·布蒂吉格在州代表票数上领先。

sentences.en: That second number has as much to do with geographic distribution of a candidate support as it has to do with the actual raw numbers of the vote.
sentences.zh: 第二个数字既与候选人支持的地理分布有关，也与实际的原始投票数有关。

sentences.en: And it's that number, the state delegates, that is the traditional measure of who wins
sentences.zh: 正是这个数字——州代表，才是衡量谁赢得爱荷华州的传统标准。

sentences.en: Iowa.
sentences.zh: 爱荷华。

sentences.en: So what you're seeing right now is both candidates trying to claim victory.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在看到的是两位候选人都试图宣称胜利。

sentences.en: They're not complete, but results are in from a majority of precincts.
sentences.zh: 它们还不完整，但大部分选区的结果已经出炉。

sentences.en: And they show our campaign in first place.
sentences.zh: 它们显示我们的竞选处于第一位。

sentences.en: We see Buttigieg come out on Tuesday afternoon, shortly after these partial results are announced,
sentences.zh: 我们看到布蒂吉格在周二下午、即这些部分结果公布后不久现身，

sentences.en: and deliver an emotional speech claiming victory and validation and sounding for all the world like a man turning toward a general election against President Trump.
sentences.zh: 发表了一场感人的演讲，宣称取得胜利和认可，听起来完全是一个准备迎接对阵特朗普总统的大选的人。

sentences.en: A campaign that some said should have no business even making this attempt has taken its place
sentences.zh: 一场曾有人说根本不该尝试的竞选活动，已经占据了

sentences.en: at the front of this race to replace the current president with a better vision for the future.
sentences.zh: 这场取代现任总统的竞选的最前沿，并对未来有着更好的愿景。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Bernie Sanders is pushing hard on the idea that the popular vote, the count that matters in normal primary elections is the most important measure of support here.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，伯尼·桑德斯在大力推行这样一种观点：在正常初选中至关重要的普选票数，才是这里衡量支持率最重要的标准。

sentences.en: Last night in Iowa, we received more votes on the first and second round than any other candidate.
sentences.zh: 昨晚在爱荷华州，我们在第一轮和第二轮获得的选票比任何其他候选人都多。

sentences.en: It's possible once the final results are in, that split, with Sanders claiming the most raw votes, but Buttigieg claiming the most state delegates, will remain.
sentences.zh: 一旦最终结果出炉，这种分裂可能会持续存在：桑德斯获得最多的原始选票，但布蒂吉格获得最多的州代表。

sentences.en: And neither of the top two candidates would ever concede that the other had won.
sentences.zh: 这两位领先的候选人永远不会承认对方获胜。

sentences.en: Or maybe in the end, we will end up with one clear winner, a candidate who gets to take that big traditional victory lap in the national spotlight.
sentences.zh: 或者也许到最后，我们会迎来一个明确的赢家，一个能够在聚光灯下进行传统宏大胜利巡游的候选人。

sentences.en: But we aren't there yet.
sentences.zh: 但我们还没到那一步。

sentences.en: So that's the lateSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是最新情况。

sentences.en: Tomorrow, we head to New Hampshire, where we'll start trying to understand what, if anything,
sentences.zh: 明天，我们将前往新罕布什尔州，开始试图理解这些结果对那里的选民意味着什么（如果有的话），

sentences.en: these results mean to voters there, and whether Bernie Sanders is still the favorite in a state
sentences.zh: 以及伯尼·桑德斯是否依然是在他四年前占据主导地位的那个州里的最爱，

sentences.en: that he dominated four years ago, a state, by the way, that takes a simple primary vote next Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，该州将于下周二举行简单的初选。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又惊心动魄的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和萨拉·科尼格（Sarah Koenig）主持的最新一期 Metro 节目中，讲述了人们试图保持影响力却最终失控的故事。

sentences.zh: Metro。

sentences.zh: 在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
